Show the running state of every component in the current project.

The CLI stores no running state itself; it queries the engine the deploy file's target names:
  docker   docker compose ps -a --format json
  podman   podman compose ps -a --format json
  k8s      kubectl get deployments -o json (in the project's namespace)

The output covers: running components, components that aren't started and why (marked when the reason comes from deploy.local.yaml),
and locally debugged components (mode: debug). mode: local components are processes supervised by an up in another terminal
and aren't in the table; when such a session is running, it names the process.

Usage:
  brickkit status [flags]

Examples:
  brickkit status

Flags:
  -f, --file string   Deploy file to use (e.g. deploy.prod.yaml); only this file is read and local mode is ignored
  -h, --help          help for status
      --no-local      Ignore deploy.local.yaml for this run (local mode stays switched on)

Global Flags:
      --log-level string   Level of the JSON logs on stderr (debug | info | warn | error | off) (default "off")
